title: Move old package versions to a backup directory
summary: Instead of deleting old cached packages, move them to a specified directory. This allows you to keep a backup of old versions while clearing the main cache.

steps.explain: Move the packages that would normally be deleted to a specific directory instead of removing them.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the directory where old packages will be moved.

warnings: Ensure the target directory exists and has enough space. This does not delete the files, but moves them.

rollback.explain: There is no command on this page to move files back from the backup directory to the pacman cache.
